purpose: Repair the P0739 stellar-footprint failure with a velocity-blind SINGS-plus-AllWISE fusion and produce complete development baryonic maps suitable for later morphology round trips and held-out velocity-field tests.
permittedInputs: P0740 development AllWISE W1 intensity and uncertainty arrays
Frozen P0740 hashes, WCS headers, coadd IDs, and cutout geometry
forbiddenInputs: Any validation or holdout SINGS or WISE pixel array
THINGS moment 1 or moment 2 array from any split
SPARC observed rotation speeds or errors
Any gravity-formula prediction, score, or parameter

processing.baseGeometry: Reuse P0739 sky center, image-only position angle, published inclination, extent, grid, gas registration, foreground rule, beam estimate, and mass normalization.
processing.wiseTileBackground: Subtract a robust median measured in the outer 15 percent border of each frozen cutout; retain the robust MAD noise estimate.
processing.wiseMosaic: Sample every frozen coadd on the P0739 face-on grid and combine positive, finite samples with inverse-variance weights. Tile membership was frozen before image inspection.
processing.wiseForegroundSuppression: Apply the same universal 12-MAD positive compact-residual replacement used by P0739 after mosaicking; protect the central 0.2 effective radii.
processing.crossCalibration: After independently subtracting backgrounds and matching both maps to the THINGS beam, estimate one positive per-galaxy multiplicative WISE-to-SINGS scale as the median SINGS/WISE ratio over finite overlap pixels between 0.2 and 5 effective radii where both maps exceed three robust noise levels and remain below their 99.5-percent positive caps.
processing.crossCalibrationInterpretation: The scale converts AllWISE DN morphology into the SINGS intensity system. It is an observational calibration caused by different instruments and units, not a gravity parameter or free mass normalization.
processing.fusion: Use beam-matched SINGS wherever its registered positive-weight footprint is valid and scaled beam-matched WISE elsewhere; use no kinematic information to choose the boundary.
processing.stellarMassCalibration: Normalize the completed fused morphology once to published SPARC 3.6 micron luminosity times the unchanged universal M/L=0.5.
processing.gasMassCalibration: Retain P0739 normalization to 1.36 times published H I mass.
processing.uncertaintySensitivity: Report cross-calibration scales from four fixed sky quadrants and the full overlap; do not tune the fusion from a gravity residual.

claimBoundary: P0741 is a development-only observational registration test and cannot validate or rank gravity formulas.
The per-galaxy WISE/SINGS scale is disclosed as instrument cross-calibration; the completed stellar map still receives only one published-luminosity mass normalization.
Passing P0741 says that later formula failures are less likely to be caused by a rectangular stellar-image footprint; it does not prove the unobserved outskirts are uniquely reconstructed.
Validation and holdout pixel arrays and every kinematic target remain sealed.
